name: Rice Cakes
siboNotes: Plain rice cakes are well-tolerated and safe for SIBO diets. Choose varieties without high-FODMAP additives like onion or garlic powder.
preparationTips: Choose plain varieties without added seasonings that may contain FODMAPs
Check ingredient labels for garlic powder, onion powder, or high-FODMAP grains
Brown rice cakes provide more fiber but both white and brown rice varieties are low FODMAP
Store in airtight container to maintain crispness
nutritionalHighlights: Provides small amounts of manganese and niacin
Quick energy from easily digestible carbs
